INSERT INTO users (email, username, password_hash, role, status)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
            ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET
                role = EXCLUDED.role,
                status = EXCLUDED.status,
                password_hash = COALESCE(users.password_hash, EXCLUDED.password_hash),
                updated_at = now()
            RETURNING id
